facts.fact: The CDP published its report for the fourth quarter of 2025 on 12 February 2026.
The CDP's fourth-quarter 2025 report says it handled 165 files, granted 39 of 41 authorisation requests, and logged 14 complaints and 2 reports.
In its fourth-quarter 2025 report the CDP deferred three video-surveillance files, naming Hotel Novotel Dakar, Clinique Dabia and Senediis Sarl, and set corrective requirements for each.
